title: Playoff Games at Petco Park This week: Expect Downtown Areas to be Busy
description:
From police and fire crews, to stormwater, transportation, park & rec, fleet operations, rangers and more — our City teams are out working in your community! They're also cheering on the Padres this postseason, along with Mayor Todd Gloria.

With playoff games at Petco Park this week, expect downtown areas to be busy. 

Plan for crowds and traffic near the ballpark. Remember to check parking times at metered spots. Try carpooling or MTS to save some time!

#TrafficTips #PadresPlayOffs #CityofSanDiego
